title: Starting out following Chris Kelly's band around 1923
summary: Colar says he began by following Chris Kelly's band and others as a kid; at about 18 he lived near Marigny and Rampart and recalls trains to the Exclusion baptisms.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I'd like to ask you first of all is how you started playing around what time that was and with what band you first started playing about 23

started out following Chris Kelly's band, Wooden Jewels, Lions Band, Cuckoo, Buddy Petit, points of, I was a kid, but actually I mean played with during that time like followed Chris Kelly, set and played with him, Wooden Jewels,
and René and the kids was going set and played. In 23, how old were you then?

I was around about 18 years old. I was living around Marigny and Ramport there. We used to be a little depot there. They used to run down Point Lash Exclusion down there. Chris Kelly and all. They used to play down there. They used to have baptism down there in Exclusion. The train used to run down there. Used to hop off it, pick blackberries, and get back on it and ride down there. About 40 miles would take you a night and a day to get out there. So you just got to get back on it.
